title: Influence of FMR1/FMRP-Expression on follicular maturation and ovarian reserve
summary: This study is looking at cells and fluid from women with different egg reserve levels (some with early menopause, some getting IVF) to find genetic clues about fertility, using genetic techniques to understand why some women have fewer or lower-quality eggs

interventions.name:
POR (Poor Responder)	
POI (Premature Ovarian Failure/ Insufficiency)

NOR (Normal Ovarian Response)/ Controls

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Clinical criteria:
NOR
• Patients from the IVF/ICSI program, without evidence of oocyte maturation disorders
• AMH > 1.1 ng/ml
• FSH < 12 mIU/ml
• Sonographic AFC (Antral Follicle Count) > 5-7

OR
POR
• DOR: Reduced ovarian reserve
• AMH level 0.5 - 1.1 ng/ml
• FSH level > 12 mIU/ml
• Sonographic AFC (Antral Follicle Count) < 5-7
Additional criteria for a high risk of POR in the context of controlled ovarian hyperstimulation in [2]:
• 40 years
• < 3 oocytes retrieved during previous stimulation

OR
POI
• Secondary hypergonadotropic amenorrhea
• < 40 years
• AMH < 0.5 ng/ml

• FSH > 40 mIU/ml

• Sonographic AFC (Antral Follicle Count) usually equal to 0
Exclusion criteria:
Patients of the fertility clinic and hormone clinic of our department who, after medical history and explanation about this study, do not meet the above criteria
